# Facebook API fixtures

**Synthetic** responses shaped like the documented Graph API v27.0 `/{page-id}/published_posts` output
(see docs/FACEBOOK-SYNC.md for the reference pages). They are not real posts: no real Facebook API call
has been made, and no institute content is reproduced. Replace or extend them with anonymized real
responses after the first real run (docs/FACEBOOK-SYNC.md, "First run checklist").
